verdict: Ads went dark Sep 15; leads and visibility have stalled since.
narrative: You received 23 leads this period, all generated before September 15 — paid spend has been at $0 for the 15 days since, which has stopped new lead flow entirely. Organic visibility is also down: Google Business Profile actions fell 40% week-over-week, with near-zero activity in the last three days of the period. On top of that, 288 contacts are in your pipeline but no appointments have been booked, which points to a gap in how incoming leads are being followed up on. Ads are being reactivated and the intake process is being reviewed to ensure leads that do come in are converting. Next period, you should see lead flow resume once spend is live again.
